name: Vellora Impact Limited
about: Vellora Impact Limited supplies agricultural commodities and provides information technology solutions in India. The agriculture division offers grains including wheat and bajra, along with pulses such as rajma, kabuli chana, and urad. It also supplies fresh vegetables including onions, carrots, cucumbers, capsicum, and tomatoes. Additionally, the division provides specialty commodities including peanuts and soybeans for food processing and industrial applications. The information technology division offers website development, software solutions, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and digital transformation services. Vellora Impact Limited was formerly known as Pratiksha Chemicals Limited and changed its name to Vellora Impact Limited in April 2026. Vellora Impact Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
